_readme: Data folder locations for each device, read by LatticeEDM_analysis_library.get_datadrive().
Look-up order: LATTICEEDM_DATA environment variable, then 'machines' (keyed by hostname), then 'defaults' (keyed by sys.platform).
Find a device's hostname with:  python -c "import platform; print(platform.node())"
Paths may use forward slashes and ~ (home folder) on any OS.
